## Abstention ("I cannot tell") and its limits

- Abstained: Risk Operations Analyst | Remote — location 'Remote' does not say the country. My verdict: y. The text does not name a country either.
- Abstained: Risk Operations Analyst - RBO | Remote — location 'Remote' does not say the country. My verdict: y. The text does not name a country either.
